name: What is the typical process for a new room addition project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a new room addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new room addition project typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and requirements. This is followed by site assessment, design and architectural planning, and obtaining necessary permits. Once approvals are secured, construction commences, involving foundation work, framing, roofing, utility extensions, and interior finishing. Frasheski Construction guides clients through each phase, ensuring clear communication and adherence to local building codes in areas like Berkeley and Oakland, which can vary and impact the permitting timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, permitting, and construction, with careful attention to local building codes.
